payload.posture: Read Ezekiel 47:1–12 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states a measured river deepens, heals waters, sustains trees, and leaves some marshes unchanged. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
